description: AMR Fleet Control agent of the warehouse WCS tier (read-only): the VDA 5050 master control of the autonomous mobile robots. It answers where a leg stands, what the robots are doing and how much capacity the fleet has. It never changes data: legs are requested and cancelled by material-flow-control over REST.
name: amr-fleet-control

skills.description: The map version, handoff points, every robot's PackML state, battery and errors, and the capacity counts. Arguments: fleetId (required). Answers a fleet-not-found problem for a fleet the map does not name. Persists nothing.
skills.name: Read the fleet

skills.description: The fleet's QUEUED, ASSIGNED, PICKED_UP and CANCEL_REQUESTED legs in acceptance order. Arguments: fleetId (required). Answers a fleet-not-found problem for a fleet the map does not name (never an empty list). Persists nothing.
skills.name: List the open legs

skills.description: One leg: container, from and to handoff points, status, robot, and once failed the reason and the robot's errorType. Arguments: fleetId, legId (required). Answers a fleet-not-found problem for an unknown fleet and a leg-not-found problem for an unknown leg.
skills.name: Read one leg

skills.description: One robot: connection, PackML state, battery, charging, availability, node, mission, errors. Arguments: fleetId, manufacturer, serialNumber (required). Answers a fleet-not-found problem for an unknown fleet and a robot-not-found problem for a robot not seen yet (a robot appears on its first report, so a later read may find it).
skills.name: Read one robot
